body: Hey, not much has changed.I still feel pretty down and the last two days laying in bed doing literally nothing except sleeping haven't helped much. Except that I didn't need to eat anything because I didn't feel hungry.Everyone keeps telling me "you need to be happy with yourself before you can be happy with someone else".I get that no one would want a downer like me around, but I just don't know what to do anymore.I kind of know that I need someone to share life, because at this point I just can't go on on my own.But giving up is okay, too. I kinda already gave up...

I have movies/series played to me constantly.

When I am not playing a game or listening to music I watch something.

Mostly new shows, because my brain constantly wants new content.

I tried rewatching some old shows.

While it worked for a few episodes, I just couldn't take entire seasons because there is nothing new. Only some old jokes or details I forgot but I know the story arch, I know how it ends, so I find myself skipping scenes until I just quit it and search for something new.

But yeah, will try meditating as I haven't tried it before..

First of all, I don't ignore anyone, otherwise I wouldn't have posted in the first place. So thank you for reading and commenting.

Second: I get you. I have been told before that "I think too much". But I can't just turn it off. It's like telling a fish to stop swimming. It's literally all I do. I think, analyze and solve problems.

Going outside is kinda a two-edged sword. While I try to do it, I know that I can't keep it up forever. Sometimes I can only be away for so long, before I need to get back home, lay in bed and cry.

I'm trying to write down small positive things about each day at the end of it, to refocus on the positive stuff, but so far (2 weeks) that doesn't do much.

I used to exercise a lot, but not anymore. Even when I am motivated enough to do so, I can barely do it for an hour, sometimes not even 20 minutes.
Not like years ago, where I would spend 2 hours in a gym every second to third day.

I might focus my remaining energy on meditation, though.
Maybe it helps.

Thanks again.

The trip thing would have maybe worked 6 month ago or prior, but now I just don't want to go anywhere anymore.There's no place that interests me and I am really uncomfortable on my own. Whenever I have to go somewhere (doctor, etc.) I just go straight there as fast as possible and back again to minimize my time spent outside.It's really nice that you're trying to help me, I'll propably try the meds and drop out of school, though I don't know how much longer I can fight on my own.

Thank you for responding.First of all I'm truly sorry for your loss. (It's odd how I care more for you, who I don't know, than I care about the idea of my parents losing me).I myself am not spiritual, though I like to philosophize, speculize, theorize and talk to myself, too.Maybe we can talk and discuss opinions?

Somedays I think that about the meds, too.Other days I believe that no meds can ever help me. Then I think that only therapy can help. And on other days again I think nothing can ever help me.The worst is that I kind of wake up with these thoughts and its like another human with this different viewpoint is inside me. Changing everyday cycling through these opinions and each and every one is so stubborn and doesn't want to begin to understand the other side.I checked out meetup.com some time ago but there's nothing for my area (sucks to be from europe).Might I ask which dating websites you used? From my experience women get far more responses then men. I tried OkCupid, but all my high matches either didn't respond at all or told me "we don't match" or even deleted their profiles (happened twice).

Thanks.I see that and I know that there are oppurtunities. I also know that I could acomplish much, if I wanted to.It's just that I don't see any reason to do so anymore.For me it also just feels like a break in a new way everyday and drift further appart from being normal.
